    T.I. (Clifford Joseph Harris Jr.), born September 25, 1980, is an American rapper, actor, and producer from Atlanta, Georgia, widely recognized as a "King of the South". Active since the early 2000s, he has secured multiple awards and film roles. He is married to Tameka "Tiny" Harris and has recently been involved in his family's life, including his children's milestones. 
    This video shows a previous legal issue involving the rapper T.I.:

    Key Facts About T.I. 
    • Real Name: Clifford Joseph Harris Jr.
    • Age: 45 years old (as of September 2025/2026, based on a Sept 25, 1980 birthdate).
    • Origin: Bankhead, Atlanta, GA.
    • Monikers: Tip, Rubberband Man, King of the South.
    • Career Highlights: Debuted in the early 2000s, known for albums like Paper Trail and hits featuring artists such as Rihanna.
    • Film/TV: Starred in ATL, American Gangster, and reality show T.I. & Tiny: The Family Hustle.
    • Recent News (2026): Releasing new music ("Let 'Em Know") and supporting his daughter’s collegiate milestones. 
    Family and Personal Life 
    • Wife: Tameka "Tiny" Cottle (married 2010).
    • Children: He has multiple children, with his son King recently making headlines regarding a viral incident. 
    Other Potential Meanings 
    • Texas Instruments (TI): A global semiconductor design and manufacturing company.
    • Titanium (Ti): A chemical element with atomic number 22.
